description: Counts a number of cells in a range that contains numbers ignoring empty cells or those contaning text.

params.description: Up to 255 items, or ranges to count numbers.The first argument is required, subsequent arguments are optional. Arguments can be numbers, logical values and text representations of numbers, ranges, names, or arrays.
params.name: args
params.type: string | number | boolean | (string | number | boolean)[] | ApiRange | ApiName

signature: COUNT(args: string | number | boolean | (string | number | boolean)[] | ApiRange | ApiName): number
